name: Sweet Lake Biscuits (Draper, UT) Two Scrambled Eggs with Sliced Avocado Toast
whyItWorks: Soft scrambled farm eggs paired with fresh mashed ripe avocado on toasted sourdough bread with light sea salt. Healthy monounsaturated fats, bioavailable protein, and potassium.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order two scrambled eggs with sourdough toast and sliced avocado (hold tomato slices and red pepper flakes).
